DEFECTS: Lantern BEFORE has a flat gray overlay with a displaced warm crescent along its upper-right edge and a smeared base; it does not read as a naturally unlit paper lantern.
Wool BEFORE is selectively blurred into a smooth tan patch while adjacent furniture remains sharp; the change reads as focus correction rather than material transformation.
Oak BEFORE is covered by a large brown, blurred patch with hard rectangular boundaries, spill beyond the chest, and obscured contours; the pair fails clean silhouette alignment.
Glass BEFORE replaces the city with nearly uniform navy paint, leaving cutout edges around the lantern and darkening its top handle; the edit is not confined cleanly to the glass.

The establishing and final frames already show essentially the same finished materials and lighting; the intervening pairs restore damaged-looking patches rather than deliver a convincing cumulative transformation.
